{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify the six QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
test_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Check their status
print("Status of QA orders:", test_orders['status'].tolist())

# Count how many are completed
qa_completed = test_orders[test_orders['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

# Total completed orders before removing QA orders
total_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

# Remove QA orders and recompute completed count
df_clean = df[~df['revenue'].isin([999999.99])]
completed_count_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

# Output results
test_orders, qa_completed, total_completed, completed_count_clean"}
